rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese way to refer to refreshing a webpage or display to show the latest data.

example.english: Tap refresh once, and the webpage will show the latest data.
example.traditional: 你撳一下重新整理，個網頁就會出最新資料。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam6 jat1 haa5 cung4 san1 zing2 lei5 go3 mong5 jip6 zau6 wui5 ceot1 zeoi3 san1 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this for reloading a webpage or document so that new changes appear.

example.english: After editing the webpage, click refresh to see the latest version.
example.traditional: 個網頁改完內容，要撳重新載入先睇到最新版本。
example.jyutping: go3 mong5 jip6 goi2 jyun4 noi6 jung4 jiu3 gam6 cung4 san1 zoi3 jap6 sin1 tai2 dou2 zeoi3 san1 baan2 bun2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when something restores alertness or energy.

example.english: I drink a glass of iced lemon tea to refresh myself.
example.jyutping: jam2 bui1 dung3 ning2 caa4 ho2 ji5 tai4 san4

rows.note: Use this when a person feels refreshed again after resting or sleeping.

example.english: After a good night's sleep, I refresh and feel full of energy again.
example.jyutping: fan3 baau2 jat1 gok3 ngo5 zing1 san4 faan2 saai3
